groups.note: E17 は離散家族が「年老いて死んでいく」ことを書いていない
diff: The Korean original says the ten million members of separated families are growing old and dying without even knowing whether their relatives are alive (English edition: only “unable even to know whether their relatives on the other side are alive or dead”).

groups.note: E84 の「three hours」は英語だけ（韓国語は「1時間、2時間と時が過ぎても」）
diff: The Korean original says “One hour, two hours passed” (English edition: “One hour passed, then two hours, three hours”).

groups.note: E89 は「그게 답입니다그려（それが答えですよ）」を省いた言い回し
E113 の「told his son, Kim Jong Il」は K23 の終わり（김정일에게 신신당부했다니）にあたり、K22 と K23 にまたがる
E124 は「참으로 보람된 일이었습니다（本当にやりがいのあることだった）」を省いた言い回し
